page-gutter.$description: The distance from the window edge to everything on it, and between the rail and the content, set on the frame that holds both (see "The rail is a CARD, not a wall" in docs/design-language.md). The content's own padding is a separate distance.

rail-narrow.$description: The rail's width in glyph mode. A fixed number so every app's rail is the same width; the brand mark fits the rail. The wide rail is 14rem, on Tailwind's own scale.

nav-row-h.$description: A rail row and a page-level tab are one height, so a Settings tab and the nav row beside it line up. A pinned well, the big page-level picker, is a step lower.

text-status.$description: The type scale, a fixed table of five sizes, one per role. --text-meta serves a card's notch badge, .glim-eyebrow's uppercase label, the info bubble, a muted meta line and a count; the treatment carries the distinction. A page's hero figure, a brand wordmark and text drawn inside an illustration are outside the scale (docs/design-language.md, "The type scale").

org.glimstone.tailwindNote: The type scale as text-status, text-title, text-body, text-subline and text-meta. Each key names its own runtime property, which works because @theme compiles into a cascade layer that the unlayered :root in tokens.css outranks.
org.glimstone.note: 22px, the status head and a tile's one figure
16px, an emphasised row title, a window's title
13px, the text beside or under a name, a hint, a time

text-heading.$description: Aliases for apps that read the four-step names.
